title: Refund Release and Refund Deadlines on Marketplace Orders Returns
content:
**Standard.** The item refund of a Marketplace Orders return is released at the option's refund trigger. Where the trigger is the first carrier scan, the refund is released at that scan only when the order total is at or below the first-scan maximum, the buyer's profile is at least the first-scan minimum account age old on the scan date, and the return history policy does not block it; otherwise it waits for the received-at-destination scan. Where the trigger is seller receipt, the refund is released at the received-at-destination scan after inspection. In every case the refund is due no later than the option's refund deadline in business days after the received-at-destination scan; when a seller has not refunded by then, Northloop issues the refund on the seller's behalf, still funded by the seller. A seller-fault return whose item unit price is at or below the option's returnless maximum may be requested as returnless and is refunded on the request date without any scan. Original shipping and tax components are released together with the item component.

## First-scan release: all three conditions

| Order total at or below the first-scan maximum | Buyer profile at least the minimum age on the scan date | Return history does not block | Item refund released |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | at the first carrier scan |
| no | any | any | at the received-at-destination scan |
| any | no | any | at the received-at-destination scan |
| any | any | no (blocked) | at the received-at-destination scan |

This table applies only where the option's trigger is the first carrier scan.

## Points of judgement

- **Seller-receipt trigger:** the refund is released at the received-at-destination scan, after inspection.
- **Deadline:** whatever the trigger, the refund is due no later than the refund deadline in business days after the received-at-destination scan. If the seller has not refunded by then, Northloop issues it on the seller's behalf, and the seller still funds it.
- **Returnless:** available only to a seller-fault return whose item unit price is at or below the returnless maximum; it is refunded on the request date with no scan.
- **Other components:** original shipping and tax are released with the item component.

### Hypothetical case

On a hypothetical first-scan option with a USD 500.00 maximum and a 90-day minimum age, an order totalling USD 120.00 from a buyer whose profile is 200 days old on the scan date, and whose history does not block, is refunded at the first scan. The same return from a profile 60 days old waits for the received-at-destination scan. The figures are example inputs.
